primitives.note: Pulverize deals magic AoE damage on cast, cooldown-gated, blockable by spell shield
Headbutt deals magic damage on arrival if the target is still within 400 units; in a stationary dummy fight this condition is trivially met
Trample deals persistent tick damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s over a 5s duration
Each tick that damages a champion grants Alistar a Trample stack, capped at 5, that lasts for the ability's remaining duration
At 5 Trample stacks, Alistar's next basic-attack on-hit (within a stated window) consumes the stacks to deal bonus magic damage and stun
Mana costs of 50-100 per cast against cooldowns of 10-14s (Q/W/E) and 80-120s (R) could matter for a low-mana Alistar early, though usually not binding by late game
Triumphant Roar's self-heal (5% max HP at 7 stacks) reduces net damage taken; unread by the damage-only fight but relevant to the survival fight
Unbreakable Will's 55-75% incoming damage reduction and CC cleanse only matter to the survival fight; it deals no damage itself

needsBespoke.why: Alistar's offensive kit reduces cleanly to two plain-cast magic-damage abilities (Q, W) and a ticking DoT (E) that also builds up to 5 self-stacks arming one empowered basic attack. Those map onto plain-cast + dot + stacking-self-buff + empowered-attack without needing custom logic. P's heal and R's damage reduction are pure defensive-only effects that a damage fight never reads and a survival fight reads as heal/damage-reduction, both expressible with existing categories.

unsettled.question: Does Trample's 5-stack empowered on-hit bonus damage (magic, described as 'proc damage') behave like normal on-hit magic damage that can be modified by AD-based on-hit riders/crit, or is it a fixed proc that never crits and is excluded from on-hit item interactions beyond Guinsoo's Phantom Hit?
options: Treated as ordinary on-hit damage, benefits from crit/on-hit amps like other magic on-hit procs
Fixed proc damage instance that never crits and only interacts with on-hit systems as explicitly noted (e.g. Rageblade Phantom Hit)
quotes: ''Trample'' deals {{tip|persistent area damage}} damage around '''Alistar''', while the bonus damage on the resulting attack is {{tip|proc damage}}.
The bonus damage and stun can be applied by {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} Phantom Hit if the triggering attack did not.

options: 6 seconds is correct and FullChargeDuration is an unrelated/stale bin field
5 seconds (FullChargeDuration) is the live value and the wiki's '6 seconds' is outdated or describes something else

proposal: Open by casting Trample (E) to become ghosted and start its persistent ticking magic damage and stack generation, since it has no cast time and should be running for as much of the 15s window as possible.
Auto-attack the dummy continuously throughout the fight; Trample's ticks will land automatically while Alistar is within range.
Cast Pulverize (Q) for its upfront AoE magic damage as soon as it is available.

Cast Headbutt (W) at point-blank range against the dummy for its magic damage; since the dummy is stationary and already close, the dash covers negligible distance and does not meaningfully delay follow-up actions.
As soon as Trample reaches 5 stacks, land the next basic attack to consume the stacks for the bonus magic damage and stun (stun is irrelevant to damage but the bonus damage is not).
Recast Q and W on cooldown, interleaved with continued auto-attacking, for the remainder of the 15s window.
Recast Trample (E) again as soon as its cooldown allows, to keep the DoT and stack-building cycle going for a second (partial) cycle within the 15s fight.
Do not use Unbreakable Will (R): it provides only damage reduction and CC cleanse, neither of which increases damage against a passive dummy.
